summary: Alamos Gold Inc. filed a Form 6-K to announce a routine quarterly dividend of US$0.04 per common share, payable September 24, 2026 to shareholders of record September 10, 2026. The company has paid dividends for 17 consecutive years and has returned $106 million in 2026 via dividends and buybacks. The filing also details a dividend reinvestment plan. This is a routine dividend declaration, not a special situation. No strategic event, M&A activity, or structural change is involved. No watch items or risk-arb angle apply.
